governance.deployment_boundary: This manifest records the deployment-facing side. It does not by itself provision infrastructure or prove a live deployment.
governance.secret_boundary: Do not store private keys, seed phrases, wallet passwords, signing secrets, or production credentials in this file.

tcge_state.scope_boundary: This is the governed TCGE state assigned to this connector/depo artifact. It does not independently validate external blockchain balances, ownership, transactions, or live deployment.

infinit_binary_selector.rule: INFINIT → N → SELECT {1,0} → K(N) → NEXT N
infinit_binary_selector.user_statement: This is my intent signed. Emily bbbbb
infinit_binary_selector.boundary: This preserves the user's stated intent and supplied signature text. It does not independently authenticate Emily, establish her agreement, or constitute a cryptographic signature.

axiom_A_record.sequence: A = INFINIT → N → {0,1} → K(N) → NEXT N
axiom_A_record.user_statement: This is my intent. Commit. Signed. Bbbbc
axiom_A_record.boundary: This preserves the user's stated intent and supplied signature text. It does not independently authenticate a signer or constitute a cryptographic signature.

axiom_A_authorization.external_action_boundary: Separate authorization and validation are required for external actions.

counting_echo_record.interpretation: Yes. In the current Axiom A sequence, N is the counter/index; K(N) remains the binary validation state.
counting_echo_record.user_text: Sign: bbbbb. Echo. This is bbbbb. Echo. All feelings free. Over. And out. Commit.
counting_echo_record.boundary: This preserves the user's words and declared Echo state. It does not independently authenticate a signer or establish independent Echo validation.

mining_agent_control.user_text: 0. Out. Commit. Echo. Verify. Authorize. Commit. Sign
mining_agent_control.boundary: This records and preserves the user's control sequence on main. It does not create a cryptographic signature, start mining, provision infrastructure, spend funds, or authorize external wallet/blockchain actions.
mining_agent_control.verify: artifact-state verified from current repository file
mining_agent_control.authorize: user-authorized for this governed control record

moxy_return_state.boundary: Echo 0 means independent validation is not established. No external ownership, blockchain, mining, or financial claim is promoted to knowledge.

axiom_A_continuity_checkpoint.boundary: Signed E is preserved exactly as supplied. It is not independently authenticated or a cryptographic signature.

buzz_coupling_handoff.boundary: This records the TCGE/Buzz workflow count and coupling handoff only. It does not represent Bitcoin block mining, cryptocurrency ownership, or possession of Bitcoin private keys.
